mentions.name: StreamCondor
mentions.description: StreamCondor is a system tray app that monitors and launches livestreams. It uses Streamlink as its backend for stream handling, stays out of the way, and notifies the user about livestreams.
mentions.problem: Streamlink is a capable tool for livestreams but has no UI; the author wanted something unobtrusive that stays in the system tray and provides notifications.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I continue to work on my monitor+launcher for livestreams. It uses Streamlink that is a magnificent piece of work but has no UI. Anyway I wanted something that stays out of the way and notify me (I love system tray apps). Does it make any sense?

https://github.com/tarzasai/StreamCondor
